lede: Mike Flanagan's Carrie lands on Prime Video, HBO's War kicks off, and Apothecary Diaries returns, with Animals, Hokum and Sacrifice just days out.

shortlist.title: Carrie
shortlist.meta: Created by Mike Flanagan; Summer H. Howell leads. 8 episodes, all dropping at once.
shortlist.blurb: Flanagan reimagines Stephen King's novel for the social-media era, and early critics call it nothing like what you expect. Binge-ready for horror season.

shortlist.title: War
shortlist.meta: Created by George Kay (Lupin, Hijack); Dominic West, Sienna Miller, Marisa Tomei, Kelly Macdonald. 8 episodes, weekly Thursdays.
shortlist.blurb: A tech mogul and a film star fight a scorched-earth divorce in a sharp HBO/Sky legal drama with a stacked cast and a two-season commitment.

shortlist.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
shortlist.meta: Anime adaptation; Crunchyroll fall 2026 simulcast, new episodes weekly.
shortlist.blurb: The sharp-minded apothecary Maomao returns to the palace intrigue in one of anime's best-written mystery series.

movies.title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
movies.blurb: Jamie Foxx's new stand-up special is streaming on Hulu and sits at 90% on Rotten Tomatoes.

tv.title: East of Eden
tv.blurb: Netflix's Steinbeck adaptation with Florence Pugh as Cathy Ames; reviews are strong (RT 89%).

tv.title: Reasonable Doubt Season 4
tv.blurb: The Hulu legal drama returns for a fourth season.

tv.title: Bass X Machina
tv.blurb: New adult animated series on Netflix.

tv.title: Physical: 100 Mexico
tv.blurb: The Mexican edition of Netflix's brutal competition franchise, still fresh if you missed it; Physical: 100 Italy followed on Sep 11.

anime.title: Black Clover Season 2
anime.blurb: Black Clover returns on Crunchyroll as part of the fall simulcast lineup.

anime.title: Magic Knight Rayearth
anime.blurb: A fresh anime adaptation of the CLAMP classic, with an English dub from day one.

anime.title: Hotel Inhumans Season 2
anime.blurb: Second season of the Crunchyroll series.

anime.title: Get Jiro
anime.blurb: New episodes of the anime series stream on HBO Max.

catalog.title: Terror in Resonance
catalog.blurb: Shinichiro Watanabe's anime thriller joins the Criterion Channel's October lineup.

catalog.title: The Fly
catalog.blurb: Cronenberg's body-horror classic arrives on Peacock for Halloween season.

catalog.title: House on Haunted Hill
catalog.blurb: The Vincent Price classic joins HBO Max with other vintage horror.

announced.title: Below
announced.blurb: Netflix's six-part sea-creature thriller with Josh Hartnett, Mackenzie Davis and Charlie Heaton lands tomorrow.

announced.title: Animals
announced.blurb: Ben Affleck directs and stars in a ransom thriller with Kerry Washington, Gillian Anderson and Steven Yeun; Netflix streams it Oct 9.

announced.title: Hokum
announced.blurb: Damian McCarthy (Oddity) directs Adam Scott in an Irish folk-horror film; it hits Hulu Oct 10 to good reviews.

announced.title: VisionQuest
announced.blurb: Marvel series with Paul Bettany's Vision and James Spader's Ultron arrives on Disney+.

announced.title: Crystal Lake
announced.blurb: Peacock's Friday the 13th prequel series premieres Oct 15.

announced.title: Sacrifice
announced.blurb: Romain Gavras's satirical thriller with Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy (TIFF 2025) lands on Netflix Oct 16.

announced.title: Dead-End Job
announced.blurb: Eight-episode Korean fantasy-horror with Lee Jae Wook and Go Min Si.

announced.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3
announced.blurb: Season 3 is set for Prime Video on Nov 11.

announced.title: The Altruists
announced.blurb: Julia Garner and Anthony Boyle star in a Netflix series premiering Nov 19.

announced.title: Blade Runner 2099
announced.blurb: Hunter Schafer and Michelle Yeoh star in the Blade Runner 2049 follow-up; all eight episodes drop Nov 25.
